race.comment: SUNDAY SWEET TALK (6) sets the standard after winning all three starts, all at Albion Park over this trip, and she has already beaten key rivals IM FRANKEE and POZZI TONOZZI in the past fortnight. Big chance to maintain the perfect record despite the handicap. EL BANDOLERO (1) is the unknown element, debuting from the front mark after a trial at Albion Park last week, so any market respect would be notable against exposed form. IM FRANKEE (7) keeps finding SUNDAY SWEET TALK too sharp but was only beaten just over a metre last start and brings consistent form. POZZI TONOZZI (5) is reliable for the minor money, with recent thirds behind the same winner and a sound overall record.
